targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-853 (GOV-FANOUT-1 H2 leg of V3-EXQ-794a's 3-hypothesis portfolio): precondition_unmet correctly flagged (dose_levels_separated and inflation_lowers_rv both fail; run is non_degenerate=false per its own gate), but the self-route's implicit framing ('substrate not ready, needs more compute') does not survive scrutiny of the actual numbers. Dose separation between LO/HI asymmetry SHRANK monotonically as training extended (smoke 4.35e-04 -> 794a[30 eps] 1.28e-04 -> this run[150 eps] 2.48e-05), the opposite of what H2 (insufficient exposure) predicts -- more exposure should grow, not shrink, the dose-response signal if H2 were correct. Traced to a design confound: N_TRAIN_EPS (the manipulated 'exposure' axis) also linearly scales the number of F1/REM recalibration firings (K=1 sleep fires once per episode: 30 in 794a vs 150 here), so this probe cannot discriminate H2 from H1 -- both predict some behavior as N_TRAIN_EPS grows, but the observed shrinkage specifically favors H1 (more F1-damping cycles pulling both doses toward a shared asymptote) over H2. Read as WEAKENS H2, not neutral. User-confirmed 2026-08-01. Recommend a redesigned probe varying STEPS_PER_EP (episode length) instead of N_TRAIN_EPS (episode count) to raise total waking exposure WITHOUT raising F1-firing count, cleanly isolating the exposure axis from the F1-interaction axis. learning_extracted: The dose_levels_separated/inflation_lowers_rv readiness gates correctly caught a genuine saturation signature, but the self-route label's implicit 'needs more compute' framing does not match the direction of the trend: MORE training produced LESS dose separation, monotonically, across three data points (smoke/794a/this run).

N_TRAIN_EPS is a confounded manipulation for H2: it simultaneously raises total waking exposure (H2's intended axis) and total F1/REM recalibration firing count (an H1-relevant axis), so no amount of re-running this exact design at a different N_TRAIN_EPS can cleanly discriminate H2 from H1.

The observed direction (shrinking separation with more firings) is directionally more consistent with H1 (F1 damping accumulates) than H2 (exposure accumulates drift) -- this run should shift portfolio weight toward H1/H3, away from H2, not sit as a neutral non-contributory data point.
